# AstryxSwitch { #anylumino.AstryxSwitch }

```python
AstryxSwitch(value=False, *, label='', disabled=False, **props)
```

Render an Astryx switch for binary settings.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | Default   |
|----------|--------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| value    | bool   | Synchronized component value.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | `False`   |
| label    | str    | Visible or accessible label for the component.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | `''`      |
| disabled | bool   | Whether the component should render disabled.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | `False`   |
| **props  | Any    | JSON-safe Switch props. Useful keys: isLoading, isLabelHidden, description, isOptional, isRequired, status, labelIcon, labelTooltip, labelPosition, labelSpacing, className, and style. anylumino manages label, value, disabled state, and change synchronization. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/Switch>. | `{}`      |
